cohort: The study participants were children under 5 years of age within the Kilifi Health and Demographic Surveillance System (KHDSS).
finding: Bednet use among children less than 5 years old was associated with a 33% decreased incidence of malaria hospitalization.
followup_time: Up to 5 years (for children < 5 years of age during the 2008-2015 study period)
